recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No core follow-up is needed for FHIR-27134 unless a future work-group decision changes the current permissive stance that servers may try to process legacy extension-only expressions.
issue_request: FHIR-27134 requested that searchparameter.html#srch be updated from XPath-focused extension SearchParameter guidance to FHIRPath guidance, encourage expressions that select the extension value with .value, reject type assertions against the Extension node itself, allow servers to attempt legacy extension-only processing, and review core examples such as mothersMaidenName.
initial_application: HL7/fhir commit 177a10ad8a6241a1eb93396928e4337423f9788e applied the issue in August 2022 by rewriting source/searchparameter/searchparameter-notes.xml and adding .value to extension SearchParameter expressions, including the then-core mothersMaidenName definition. Subsequent source changes preserved the semantic guidance while moving standard extension SearchParameters such as mothersMaidenName to the FHIR Extension Pack.
additional_context: source/fhir.ini actively lists searchparameter=SearchParameter and maps it to FHIR-I, making source/searchparameter/searchparameter-notes.xml current build input. The current section uses FHIRPath examples ending in .value, says servers MAY attempt extension-only expressions but need not support them, and explains that casting the Extension directly creates an empty index. A scan of current core extension SearchParameter expressions found no active expression needing a .value cleanup, and the Extension Pack mothersMaidenName SearchParameter already ends in .value. Related issues FHIR-20462, FHIR-33012, FHIR-38080, and FHIR-51587 were encountered as same-section or later-context audits already represented on the combined branch.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit on the combined branch because the current source already satisfies the Published FHIR-27134 decision and no necessary core source hunk remains.
